purpose: physical Ryzen 9 equal-wall-clock comparison of the three R4 Generation-2 frozen finalists
reference_rule: exact-combo reference is trained once per board/phase/SPR and excluded from each candidate wall-clock budget
budget_rule: each candidate trains p0-restricted, p1-restricted and joint states in equal-iteration round-robin cycles until the same candidate-training wall-clock budget is reached; evaluation and checkpoint I/O occur after the budget and are recorded separately
memory_rule: each candidate/cell executes in a fresh subprocess so peak working-set/RSS is isolated from earlier candidates
decision_rule: do not invent a scalar score; compare fidelity, completed iterations, throughput, action slots, memory and checkpoint I/O as Pareto evidence
production_warning: this is physical R4 river evidence. R4 production freeze still requires compatibility with the intended R5 traversal and first R6 street architecture.
